name: Neon Night Rider Skull
description: Agresivní design lebky s kšiltovkou dozadu a neonovým dripem. Odkazuje na 'Nachtfahrer' lifestyle, noční jízdy a party vibe. Vizuálně propojuje signature barvy brandu (neon green/purple) s drsnou estetikou ulice.
designPrompt: Vector art graphic of a stylized human skull wearing a backwards streetwear baseball cap. The skull features a shiny gold tooth. Vibrant neon green and neon purple slime is dripping heavily from the empty eye sockets and jawline. High contrast, bold thick white outlines to make it pop on dark fabric. Cyberpunk streetwear aesthetic, clean lines, cel-shaded. Isolated design on solid black background, print-ready vector style, no text.
